HigherGovAPIKeyCredential.title: HigherGov API Key
HigherGovAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: An account administrator can create an API key in HigherGov: open the gear menu, then API. Paste only the key. HigherGov requires it as an api_key query parameter over HTTPS. Connecting reads your internal pursuits; reads consume your API record allowance.

ListPursuits.description: Description: Returns the authenticated client's HigherGov pursuits tied to their account and managed in https://www.highergov.com/pursuit/. This endpoint is for a user's internal pursuit records, not for searching government opportunities. If you want to look up federal contract, grant, or other opportunities or forecasts, use the Opportunity endpoint instead.   Update Frequency: Real time.
